title: SharePoint: tenant-wide usage statistics for SharePoint agents
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's overdue target and distinguishes documented reports from the still-unidentified planned statistics. The existing report's command and access requirements are supported; minor corrections should complete its UI route and acknowledge SharePoint's general licensing requirement.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to aggregate SharePoint agents' usage statistics across all SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing for this feature is not yet published and the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: To access SharePoint, users in your organization need to be assigned a license that includes SharePoint. Searched: SharePoint agent usage statistics across all SharePoint sites licensing price meter prerequisites; read SharePoint service description and SAM prerequisites; no item-specific entitlement.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included for the product-level entitlement, and replace the first licensing sentence in the notes and body with: 'SharePoint requires a licence that includes SharePoint; any additional licensing requirement specific to these planned statistics is not yet published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/sharepoint-online-service-description/sharepoint-online-service-description. Do not attribute the existing reports' SharePoint Advanced Management entitlement to the unidentified planned report.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].governs and scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The existing Agent Insights report covers recently created agents across all SharePoint and OneDrive sites within the organization.
claims.quote: The insights report on agents in SharePoint provides SharePoint administrators with rich information on the recently created agents across all SharePoint sites and OneDrive sites within their organization.

claims.claim: The Agent Insights report is built from FileCreated and FileRenamed audit data.
claims.quote: The insights report is based on the Microsoft audit data logged for the agents created in SharePoint through the FileCreated and FileRenamed events.

claims.claim: The existing creation-based Agent Insights report reports agent inventory rather than interaction frequency.
claims.quote: This report helps admins learn about the sites with the highest number of agents created. ... CopilotAgentsOnSites: Provides the name of all the agents currently available on all sites.

claims.claim: The existing report is reached in the SharePoint admin center through Reports > Agent Insights.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, expand Reports and then select Agent Insights. ... As a SharePoint Administrator, select Create a report to create the report. ... Select Create and run.
claims.fix: For a route that reaches report generation, extend controls[0].ui.path and its rendered table cell to 'Reports > Agent Insights > Create a report > Create and run'. The current route correctly reaches the report page but stops before the generation operation shown on the automation side.

claims.claim: Start-SPOCopilotAgentInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays 28 generates the existing report for 28 days.
claims.quote: Using this cmdlet, administrators may trigger the build of a new Copilot agent insight report for the specified number of days. ... The possible values of ReportPeriodInDays are: 1, 7, 14, 28.
